vicpol tracker

Aggregated opinion polling for the next Victorian state election. The Coalition leads Labor 52.8–47.2 two-party preferred on implied preference flows (±2) – updated 28 September 2026 from 64 published polls across 8 polling houses. Election day: Saturday 28 November 2026.

Two-party preferred

Labor 47.2%, Coalition 52.8% on implied preference flows — the pollsters’ own published figures read Labor 45.8%, Coalition 54.2%

the Coalition leads by 5.6 points (±4.0 on the lead) on implied preference flows – every poll’s primary votes re-allocated by the 2022 Victorian election's flows (measured from the VEC's district counts; One Nation's from the 2025 federal count), so every poll that publishes primaries counts, not only those that file a two-party figure. The figure is a smoothed trend (a Kalman smoother) through every poll this term, each counted by its sample and adjusted for its pollster’s lean, carrying a 95% interval of ±2.0 points on each share.
